text_block_list.text:
Phew! I ran like crazy today. My times
are lookin'
good too. I've gotta keep this
up.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: Do you want to call it a day?

text_block_list.text:
Nah, I'm gonna give it a bit more. My
legs are
itchin' to move.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: You can go back without me, Teach!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
We're halfway into summer camp. Hishi
Amazon
has her full attention on the
Shuka Sho and the
Arima Kinen. Not a
day has passed by without a
solo
training session.

She's making remarkable progress. I'm
positive
she's well on her way to
becoming the ideal
version of herself.
However...
Beep!

Нарита Брайан has scored a tremendous
victory!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
She finished with an incredible
five-length lead,
astounding everyone
with her beast-like run in
the Japanese
Derby in the early summer.

It's like she gets better with every race.
Is she
headed for the Kikuka Sho next?
Man, I can't
wait!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан has been making strides at
summer
camp too, and right now...
Haaaaah!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
What the?! This scrimmage is something
else!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Brian is pulling farther away from the
others...
Gosh, it's like watching an adult
race against
children.
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text:
She dominates the race with her
unbelievable
power, finishing over ten
lengths ahead of the
competition.
choice_data_list: (Will Хиши Амадзон be all right at this rate?)

text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, I think back to what she told
me
before.

I can't get that one-on-one between
Brian and
the president out of my mind.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
The entire field was silent, burning with
tension.
They took the crowd's breath
away.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: That's when I realized something.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
There's no way I'm worthy of having a
one-on-one
with Brian—not as I am now!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Seeing her so bitterly frustrated was
honestly
quite a shock to me.
choice_data_list:
(I don't want to see her make that face ever
again...)

text_block_list.text:
We have to make our time at this
summer camp
worth it, and convert it
into fuel for Хиши Амадзон
to grow.

The number of sleepless nights I
continue to have
is directly proportional
to the desire I have to
make her wish
come true.
Then, one day...
...Huh? Hey, Teach!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
...You've been kinda off lately. You're
always
staring out into space or zoning
out when I'm
talkin'.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
If you've got worries, I got ears to listen
to 'em
with!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
It looks like my lack of sleep is catching
up to me.

Are you sure? I mean, your complexion
isn't
lookin' too great.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Are you getting enough sleep? And are
you
eating properly? I can whip up
somethin' that's
easy to digest for ya.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't want to get in the way of her
training.

In order to change the subject, I quickly
show her
a core training regimen
adapted for the beach
that I extracted
from a bigger set of materials.

Y'know, this is all startin' to feel really
weird. It's
like you've got a new regimen
for me almost
every day.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
You're kinda all over the place. Like
you're antsy
about somethin'... Or no, it's
more like...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Are you feeling nervous about
something?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
My attempt to throw Хиши Амадзон off
my scent
fails miserably, and training
ends with her still
suspicious of me.

The following day, I head for the beach,
ready for
some more training, but...

Teach! Training's canceled for today!
We're
holding a scrimmage instead!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I had a talk with the president, and we
decided
that the winner will receive a
year's worth of
high-quality protein
powder.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
That prize was good enough to round up
some
real strong contenders. Well, why
don't you come
and watch the race?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
She doesn't even let me get a word in
edgewise
and sits me down in the shade.
The scrimmage
kicks off shortly after.

There are seventeen racers in total, and
all of
them have won graded races
before.

Yet despite the steep competition, Hishi
Amazon
blasts past them all at a
tremendous speed.
Graaah!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Is it just me, or is Hishiama exuding way
more
intensity than before? Just look at
that explosive
power...
text_block_list.name: Miho Student A

text_block_list.text:
The final turn is moments ahead. She
gains speed
from the outside and surges
to the front!
Haaah!
text_block_list.name: Scrimmage Racer

text_block_list.text:
Two other racers vie for the lead,
unwilling to
lose. The racers behind
them also pick up the
pace, but...
I'm not gonna lose to youuu!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон flies across the sand,
peeling away
from her competition in
the blink of an eye.
She wins by a sweeping margin.
Hishiama has always been the gutsy type, but it feels like she suddenly got way better.
text_block_list.name: Miho Student A

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's almost scary how good she's
gotten!
text_block_list.name: Miho Student B

text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Teach, whaddya make of that?!
You still
think I'm some weakling that
needs you to fuss
over her?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
In the same way that Нарита Брайан has
become a
beast of a racer...

Хиши Амадзон has made tremendous
leaps in
strength and resilience this past
spring and
summer.
choice_data_list: I'm so sorry I doubted you!

text_block_list.text:
Hmph. You finally come to your senses?
Don't go
losing your head, Teach!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I may not look it, but I'm the sort of
Umamusume
who'll never stop reaching
higher.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
And you know what? Beyond doubt,
you're the
one who helped me get this
far!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
So don't sweat the small stuff, and let's
just give
everything our very best!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
We're in this together. If we don't trust
each
other, we'll never be on the same
page.

I can't believe I lost sight of the most
important
thing.
That's my line...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Anyway! No more doom and gloom, you
hear?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: So what's the plan for today?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Sounds good. You can't do much without
a bit of
muscle on ya!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Why don't we work out right here on the
beach?
We're already here and all.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Okay, I'll start with 500 high knees!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Raaah!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sounds good! You know, I just
spotted this
huge rock!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
How about pulling that round the
island?!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Hahaha, right on! Okay, let's do this!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Haaah! Push it to the limiiit!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
In the blink of an eye, she peels off with
the
massive rock, heading beyond the
shore.

Хиши Амадзон throws her complete all
into
training. She zips around so fast, my
eyes can
barely keep up.
